pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:0.6: ime kho panāyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.1: parimaṇḍalavaggo tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū puratopi pacchatopi olambentā nivāsenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā puratopi pacchatopi olambentā nivāsessanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhogino”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū puratopi pacchatopi olambentā nivāsessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave puratopi pacchatopi olambentā nivāsethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā puratopi pacchatopi olambentā nivāsessatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk1:1.18: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambento nivāseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
